children.name: p
children: Redis keeps the entire index in RAM. A large corpus can consume significant memory, so monitor your Redis memory usage and enable persistence (RDB or AOF) if you want the index to survive a Redis restart without a rebuild. For very large datasets that don't fit comfortably in memory, SQLite is often the better fit.

frontmatter.title: Redis-backed search
frontmatter.description: A hands-on walkthrough for building a full-text search index with Redis as the storage engine, from an empty database to a search index shared across multiple servers.
